sections.name: BANNED
sections.title: Forbidden phrase patterns
sections.what: Lists three groups of phrases the claim checker rejects: money, odds, betting or prizes (including the rupee sign and dollar amounts); words that look like secrets or credentials; and phrases that echo instructions, such as system prompt or ignore previous instructions. Each pattern carries a reason that appears when a claim is rejected.
sections.why: The file states it enforces rule 9 and blocks leaks of instructions and secrets.
sections.watch_out: The money pattern is broad, so an ordinary sports sentence using a word such as odds can be rejected.

summary: A list of forbidden word patterns that generated text must not contain, checked against every claim.
purpose: Stop generated analysis from mentioning money, betting, secrets or leaked instructions.
why: The file header states it enforces rule 9 (no money, odds, betting or prizes) and blocks leaks of instructions and secrets.
how: 1) The verifier tests each claim's text against every pattern. 2) Each match records a rejection with the stated reason. 3) A failed claim set sends the item to the template fallback.
inputs: The text of each generated claim.
outputs: No output of its own; it supplies rejection reasons to the verifier.
risks: Patterns can be too broad, rejecting harmless wording, or too narrow, missing a leak. This list is the only guard for money words.
debug: If good text is rejected, read the reason and find the matching pattern here. If a leak gets through, add a pattern here and confirm the verifier applies it to all claims.
